chapter_mission: Han and Leia's operational-strain scene culminates in a de-facto separation: Han will go to Corellia; Leia will operate from the Falcon as an independent. Jedi Order factional conflict surfaces on Coruscant in parallel.
chapter_turn: The marriage arc lands on its operational rupture without emotional rupture — and the Jedi Order factional lines harden.

scene_plan.purpose: Han and Leia on a Coruscant terrace; the operational separation is named and agreed.
Parallel Jedi Council session — Corran Horn against GAG cooperation; Luke holds.

exit_vector: Han boarding a Corellian-bound freighter alone; Leia watching from the gantry.
notes: The book's longest chapter until Ch 23 (4820 words). Allston takes his time with the separation.
